Rich already has column options for this. In [`docs/source/tables.rst`](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/tables.rst), `min_width` stops a column shrinking below a set width, and `no_wrap` stops a column wrapping. Your examples don't set either on Name, Age or Country, so Rich is free to shrink them to make room for Biography. Setting `min_width` on those columns sets a floor for their widths.

For usage questions, please use [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions). Related: #2890 is about `no_wrap` squashing columns below their `min_width`.
